subject: [PATCH v3 1/3] mm/huge_memory: scale thp_underused() to the folio size

2026-10-23.patch_summary: This patch updates the thp_underused() function to be aware of the size of a folio, rather than assuming it's always PMD-sized. It scales the khugepaged_max_ptes_none threshold proportionally to the number of pages in the folio, ensuring that the same fraction of zero-filled pages is tolerated regardless of folio size. This change will prevent issues when collapsing mTHP orders and splitting folios, as both operations would use the same threshold for a given folio size. The patch makes no functional changes for PMD-sized folios, as their nr_pages value remains HPAGE_PMD_NR.
